messages:
Maria: Quick checkpoint — SOC2 sprint board: fieldwork kicks off 10/03. Can owners confirm the concrete timeline for audit log ingestion? We need a final owner for 'ingest-evidence' and a one-line status (blockers / ready) by EOD Tue.

Oliver: I can own ingest-evidence. Two quick asks: confirm retention SLA (90d vs 1y hot) and whether pipeline should read from Kinesis or GCS snapshots. Also there's a KMS rotation change scheduled this week that might touch service accounts.

Jin: Retention plan: 90 days hot, then archive to GCS (7y cold). Pipeline currently reads from kinesis:compliance-prod (low-latency). Tagging @Oliver so we can sync on KMS implications. :white_check_mark:

Maria: Thanks — assigning ownership to @Oliver here. Oliver, can you list the PRs/tasks you'll need reviewed (infra PRs, runbook updates)? Emily / Sam will pick up reviews.

Oliver: Short list: infra PR for ingest consumer config, migration for header parsing, runbook update. Test endpoint is up on prod; quick health check:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_KEY" https://ingest-prod.redwood.ai/health
# expect 200 and {"status":"ok","lag_ms":<number>}
```

If health returns 200 we're in good shape to proceed with canary.

Emily: Heads up — KMS/HSM access needs an approved service account: svc-audit-ingest@redwood.iam. @people-ops do we have pre-approval? If not, this will block the 9/28 freeze window.

Sam: FYI I have the client PR touching KV cache and the ingest client (PR #4823). ETA for review: today. @Oliver can you confirm this PR does not change the event schema? If it does, we need a shim and an evals regression test.

Oliver: No schema change — only header normalization and retry backoff. PR links: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/pulls/4823, migration script added (one-liner):

```
./scripts/migrate_headers.sh --apply --env=prod
```

DevBot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for ingest-prod -> canary=5% on us-west1. Monitor at https://deploys.redwood.ai/ingest-prod

Maria: If canary stays green for 30m, can we push the retention policy change before the snapshot freeze? Also Jin — can you confirm the nightly archive job drops items to GCS after 90d and emits metrics to prometheus?

Jin: Confirmed. Archive job runs nightly at 02:00 UTC, emits prometheus metric `audit_archive_failures` and pushes logs to stackdriver. I'll add a runbook entry and create an alert if failure rate > 5% for 3 consecutive runs. Action: create incident ticket template.

AuditBot: audit-bot: evidence-metadata updated — evidence id 987654 linked to ingest pipeline. Recorded reference 2432109999.

Maria: Recap / owners: Oliver (ingest-evidence + infra PRs), Jin (archive/runbook + alerts), Emily (KMS access coordination), Sam (client PR review). Next check-in: Thu 16:00 PT. If anyone hits blockers earlier, ping here or DM. :thumbsup:

Oliver: Acknowledged, will post PR status and any blockers in this thread.

Emily: I'll start the KMS access flow and loop in people-ops.

Sam: Reviewing PR now, will flag anything by EOD.

Maria: Thanks team — appreciate the quick sync.
